title: The Four Great Kingdoms in the World
description: The four great kingdoms surveyed as the complete fourfold ordering of natural dominion — rule extended through all the climes of the cosmos. The closing observation that "none is exalted exceedingly above them" points by negation to the King of Honor's judicial dominion above the firmaments and ultimately to the Father of Greatness whose Greatness has no measure. The ceiling of natural dominion against the truly exalted rule belonging to another order.
